missingConnectorAbstraction: Unified Governed Execution Package Builder that converts an approved mission candidate into an immutable execution package without invoking live network calls, browser automation, or fake payments.
safestExtensionPoint: Create src/services/motherExecutionConnectorService.js providing Connector Registry and Execution Package Builder with strict governance checks.
governanceRulesEnforced: Refuse package generation if Founder approval is missing (founderApproved must be true)
Refuse package generation if opportunity is unverified (sourceVerified must be true)
Refuse package generation if connector is not allow-listed or operational
Refuse package generation if required fields are missing from source evidence
Refuse package generation if mission is blocked or rejected
Refuse duplicate package generation for the same approved mission candidate
Zero live network calls, zero browser automation, zero credential storage, zero fake financial claims
